issue.title: Workspace rescue store always falls back to ~/.sase/rescue because project-key resolution ignores the checkout marker
issue.description:
`src/sase/workspace_provider/rescue.py:_project_key_for_workspace` resolves the rescue-store project key only through `sase.bead.project_name.scan_projects_for_cwd(workspace_dir)`. That scan only matches a project's primary checkout (and the old `primary_<N>` sibling layout). It returns `None` for numbered managed workspaces under the workspace store (`~/.local/state/sase/workspaces/<owner>/<repo>/<repo>_<N>`). So `_rescue_root_for_workspace` always falls back to the machine-level `~/.sase/rescue/`, and nothing lands in `~/.sase/projects/<key>/rescue/` as the module docstring and `docs/workspace.md` say.

Root cause: the helper skips the `.sase/checkout.json` marker that every managed checkout carries. The marker-aware resolver `infer_project_name_from_cwd(workspace_dir, exact=True)` resolves these workspaces correctly (`gh_sase-org__sase`, `gh_bbugyi200__tailnet`).

Fix direction: resolve the key through the marker-aware resolver, which also handles the scan fallback, and keep the `is_valid_sase_project_name` guard plus the machine-store fallback. Add a test where the workspace has a checkout marker and the rescue entry lands under the project store. The reaper already scans every `~/.sase/projects/*/rescue` root, so retention does not change. Existing entries in `~/.sase/rescue/` age out after 30 days.

task_type_fields.impact: Rescues from every project mix together in one machine-level directory instead of the documented per-project store. That makes them harder to find and attribute, and the rescue notification's "Rescue dir" points somewhere other than what the docs describe. No data is lost, because the reaper covers both roots.
task_type_fields.repro:
From any numbered workspace (verified 2026-10-17 on athena; apollo's store shows the same layout):

    uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path; from sase.workspace_provider.rescue import _project_key_for_workspace as k, _rescue_root_for_workspace as r; w=Path("<numbered workspace dir>"); print(k(w), r(w))'
    # -> None /home/bryan/.sase/rescue

    uv run python -c 'from sase.bead.project_name import infer_project_name_from_cwd as f; print(f("<numbered workspace dir>", exact=True))'
    # -> gh_sase-org__sase

`ls ~/.sase/projects/*/rescue` finds nothing on athena or apollo. Every rescue entry (45 in 202610 on athena, 57 on apollo) is under `~/.sase/rescue/`.

issue.creation_reason: Found while investigating the 'Rescued leftover state' toasts: every rescue entry on athena and apollo lands in the machine-level fallback store, contradicting the documented per-project rescue location.
